stops.title: Di Nɔmba dɛn
stops.caption: Aw di paiplain de du.
stops.speech: Di sol dashbɔd de tɔn di paiplain to nɔmba: omɔch na ɛvri stej, omɔch kɔnvat, ɛn aw fresh di fɔlo ɔp dɛn de.

stops.title: Bay Stetɔs
stops.caption: Klik wan ba fɔ si udat.
stops.speech: Di chat dɛn de brok am dɔŋ bay stetɔs ɛn bay ɔjɛnsi. Klik ɛni ba fɔ si ɛgzakli wetin pipul i de kawnt.
